decision: Require run-independent enqueue idempotency keys in attested multi-run Qubes qualification

reviews.reason: Distinct run IDs, request IDs, and mutation labels do not prove the durable enqueue deduplication identity is fresh; reusing an idempotency key can alias a prior mission.
Evidence records the actual submit idempotency identity and rejects reuse across campaigns without deleting the persistent state being tested.
No additional qrexec round trips, no daemon/database, O(number of enqueue identities) memory, and no MissionQueue/coordinator mutation-semantic change.

rejected.failure: transport identity independence does not imply mission enqueue deduplication independence
destroys the persistence/reconciliation state the qualification is intended to exercise

rejected.approach: add a persistence namespace solely for qualification
rejected.failure: changes production semantics and increases regression surface unnecessarily

qa: reject shared enqueue idempotency key across distinct runs
accept distinct run-scoped enqueue idempotency keys
include attested qualification suites in npm check/test so the gate cannot silently escape full QA
lesson: Qualification independence must be proven at every durable deduplication identity, not inferred from outer transport/run identifiers.
